context.description: The run header shows the spec title

evidence.trustReason: UI6: release-notes SPEC.md H1 and T1.2 TASK.md match fixed expected titles. Real TaskCommand.run starts one job for whole and subtree; exact first text part and structured header metadata are asserted, and SessionPrompt.command reads the stored root-session text part and metadata through the real session projector. Real MessageBody/TaskHeader renders the lead muted, task and spec titles bold, and the left-out line muted from metadata; plain text without metadata remains plain. T1.2 includes only S3 because acceptance/S3.md needs T1.2 alone; the fixed expected omitted list S1,S2,S4-S13 matches the other twelve acceptance files and is independent of TaskCommand.leftOut. Empty title falls back to spec id in header, transcript and projected written status; whole status carries title without task, subtree status carries title and task, and the Ledger draws the title. A later run changes status but the earlier header and a two-message transcript retain their own titles. Focused Bun test: 5 passed, 0 failed, 69 assertions. D16's omitted-ID and stored-metadata gaps are closed.
